name: task-tracker
description: A full-stack task management app with secure authentication and a dev-tool-inspired dark UI. Users sign up, log in, and manage their own private task list. Every request is authenticated and every task is scoped to its owner.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
